faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate I post at AIIMS Guwahati?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate I position at AIIMS Guwahati is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate I role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree (minimum 55% marks) in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biological Sciences, or a related discipline.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate I post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate I post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate I position ranges from Rs. 29500 to Rs. 36580 per month, depending on whether the candidate possesses a valid national eligibility certificate.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Project Associate I vacancy?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply by sending their complete application with bio-data and self-attested documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate I recruitment will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is Biochem/AIIMSG/26-27/1057(A).

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Guwahati.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
